l1_connect_account.title: Bring the desktop pools run apart under one console
l1_connect_account.why: Users work on these pools, but they are not managed with the others, so their images, profiles and capacity are handled by hand.
steps: List desktop pools from each site and team.
Register each pool with the console with a scoped account.
Confirm users, images and sessions show for each.
l1_connect_account.success: Every desktop pool in scope reports its users and its image.
